text: CDC Dental Center was recommended by a dear friend who brings her family and recommended seeing this dental clinic. I have always been afraid of dentists and I will bring that fear anytime I open my mouth. However, coming here has been always a good experience. The staff is very nice and cordial and although I do not speak Thai they understand enough to communicate what the concerns are and a solution. Most of the dentists speak good english and do very excellent work. I had 2 implants done and saw me same day for an emergency where my tooth cracked. Again, they were concerned and immediately remedied the tooth and fixed it. Prices compared to the U.S. are about 1/3 of the price and lower. They have specialty dentist that work on deeper problematic extractions like they did to me recently. Although they did a great job numbing me, the care and time they took to gently do my root canal was awesome (afterwards). I think I was more afraid because i couldn't see what is happening. Although there are many fancy clinics throughout Bangkok, if you want more of a personal attention family feel then CDC should be visited. It is also steps next to  Saphan Khwai BTS Station. Highly Recommended
